title: Standard Tab Scaffold — 8 sections per tab
note: Every tab wraps with: Goal · ToDo · horizontal Process Flow · Input · Process · Output · Visualization · Transaction History. Default applies when no per-tab override.

default.goal: Provide a clear, auditable workflow for this capability.
default.input: Domain data + parameters relevant to this tab.
default.process: Deterministic/AI step that transforms input to output.

seizure_diary.goal: Capture every seizure event and surface trends so risk is visible early.
seizure_diary.input: Date/time, duration, aura, awareness, motor signs, injury, ER, trigger.
seizure_diary.process: Auto-severity scoring (duration + injury + ER + recovery) + monthly aggregation.
seizure_diary.output: Severity-classified events + monthly trend + ER count + severity distribution.
seizure_diary.viz: Monthly seizure bar chart + severity distribution.

onboarding.goal: Get a patient onboarded in 8-10 min instead of 2-3 hours.
onboarding.input: Demographics, chief complaint, core history, current meds, emergency contact.
onboarding.process: Required-first capture + multi-format document extraction + field deferral.
onboarding.output: Onboarded patient with ~80 intake fields; ~1170 deferred.

workbench.goal: Drive the clinical decision from Patient → EEG → AI → Explainability → Human → Audit.
workbench.input: Patient record, EEG analysis, AI predictions.
workbench.process: Assemble evidence + AI findings + explainability for human decision.
workbench.viz: Biomarker bars + localization ranking + confidence gauges.

r_ipo.goal: Show the role's pipeline as Input → Process → Output with quality gates.

iot_fleet.goal: Handle Emotiv + IoT + mobile devices across online/offline/hybrid modes.
iot_fleet.process: Online stream OR offline buffer+sync OR hybrid edge inference.
